g.text: Member B - Case-Owned IntakeSession State Machine
MB-STM-0.2 compatibility candidate, 2026-09-14
SUBMITTED
Created with ReturnCase and original statement
Accepted intake work queued
EVALUATING
Selected current case/input work
Coordinator supplies non-authoritative result
recoverable_processing_error [recovery budget remains]
/ retry selected work; no duplicate customer input
obsolete_result [case/input/work no longer current]
/ discard result; do not overwrite current facts
AWAITING_CLARIFICATION
ReturnCase AWAITING_INFORMATION
Current targeted ClarificationSet persisted
no_response_or_ui_closed
/ no authoritative mutation or round-limit escalation
clarification_rejected [auth/input/question/state/version invalid]
/ safe error; no input accepted and no analysis started
CLARIFICATION_RECEIVED
Accepted statements/evidence appended
New input version queued for evaluation
COMPLETE
Quiescent after handoff to UC-02
Case continues outside intake; session remains durable
ESCALATED_FAILURE
Quiescent after actual current technical failure
ReturnCase follows exact-target handling; session remains durable
Subject: durable case-owned IntakeSession (M-B.04 / C10).
lifecycle_state labels and clarification_round are internal design values,
not new wire fields, CaseStatus values or a shared IntakeStatus enum.
G-REENTRY: Domain already committed a legal shared-case transition to
AWAITING_INFORMATION and a current case/input-bound ClarificationSet;
existing source/state/effect/authority guards passed. No UI-created transition.
G-TERMINAL: authoritative ReturnCase is COMPLETED, REJECTED or MANUAL_HANDLED.
Intake handoff or escalation alone never terminates this durable machine.
IntakeViewSession is a separate UI-only view/controller.
Local DRAFT, pending/error display and closing a page do not
create, reject, cancel, delete or expire a durable ReturnCase.
Reopening/recovery GETs authorised current state.
Accepted POST replay in any state creates no transition/work;
authentication and receipt-retention rules still apply.
Ordinary missing facts are not ProcessingFailure.
No proposal: exactly one real current failure/block target.
This branch persists an actual COORDINATOR failure.
Existing proposal/history remain governed by F.01.
Founder alone can record MANUAL_HANDLING on the exact target.
No-proposal failure has no revision/restart/re-entry path.
With a current proposal, only lawful Founder REQUEST_REVISION
followed by an existing assessment-gap transition may satisfy G-REENTRY.
create_committed [fresh authorised valid request]
/ Domain atomically creates case/session/input/work/receipt
accepted_work_started [selected current input]
/ invoke Coordinator
result_accepted [current binding; sufficient mandatory facts]
/ Domain persists facts and investigation handoff
result_accepted [current binding; facts incomplete/ambiguous]
/ Domain persists remaining questions; increments internal clarification_round
actual_processing_error [current work; recovery exhausted; legal target]
/ Domain persists ProcessingFailure and escalation; no automatic Founder decision
clarification_committed [fresh owner request; current question set/version]
/ atomic append and evidence binding; advance case/input; invalidate stale authority
accepted_work_started [selected current input]
/ invoke Coordinator for updated authorised input
domain_clarification_committed [G-REENTRY]
/ adopt current questions in the same durable session
domain_clarification_committed [G-REENTRY and lawful proposal-bound recovery]
/ adopt current questions; never restart a no-proposal failure
case_terminal [G-TERMINAL]
/ end session behavior; retain permitted records
case_terminal [G-TERMINAL]
/ end session behavior; retain permitted records
Original B 92cd717; A/AI-assisted compatibility candidate; personal acceptance pending.
AH-01 -> UC-01 / UC-01E -> M-B.04; Domain (A) remains sole business-state writer.
No three-round business cap, seven-day archive, or customer withdrawal transition.
COMPLETE/ESCALATED_FAILURE are durable quiescent states; only G-TERMINAL reaches final.
This conceptual internal refinement does not alter shared class/wire contracts or implement runtime behavior.
